apiUrl.title: AgentShield server URL
apiUrl.description: Base URL of the AgentShield API, for example https://agentshield.yourcompany.com. Grants no access: each user still activates the browser with their account and an activation code, and codes for other servers are refused.

dashboardUrl.title: Dashboard URL
dashboardUrl.description: Optional. Opened from the activation screen so users can sign in and generate an activation code.
